description: Global Future Drought Layers Based on Downscaled CMIP6 Models and Multiple Socioeconomic Pathways is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Diogo S. A. Araujo et al. Droughts are a natural hazard of growing concern as they are projected to increase in frequency and severity for many regions of the world. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: GeoTIFF. The data are held in Palisades, NY: Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC) and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article.
